_comment: Offline KSC package only. When the machine can reach InfraScope over HTTP, use the pull rollout instead (docs/rustdesk-ksc-deployment.md) - it fetches these same values at run time and reports the result back. Per-machine values: GET /api/v1/remote-access/devices/{id}/package. Push-RustDesk.ps1 (Windows 7 + 10, no reboot) reads this file too and overrides hidden/unattended per -Profile; installer_msi is used on Windows 10/11 x64, installer_exe32 (32-bit sciter build) on Windows 7 / 32-bit.
